documentation: Canonical artifact registry of the stack wheels this project installs (R01, 2026-10-07): repository, release tag, asset and sha256 of each published wheel. `python ../../scripts/stack_wheels.py fetch --project .` downloads them through the GitHub API (private repositories need STACK_READ_TOKEN with Contents: read) into the gitignored flat index `.stack-wheels/`; `uv.lock` pins them there by name and version. `check` fails when registry, index, uv.lock and pyproject.toml disagree or a release URL reappears.

retired_repositories.leonardosovienski/ecosystem-predictor: renamed to leonardosovienski/ecosystem-predictor-cain on 2026-10-05; the old name now hosts the public showcase, which has no releases
